Checklist presents officer termination as Rule 14 or Rule 15 only and says 'mandatory notice'. Held text shows (a) r.14(1) proviso: no show-cause where termination rests on criminal conviction, or where Government records that it is not expedient/practicable; (b) the separate r.14(3) conviction route; (c) r.13-A (failure to qualify) and r.15-A (medical release) as distinct routes (cf. ADM-007). Treating notice as always mandatory, or missing r.15-A, can produce a wrong-route order.
